# paylink.lol — Full Technical Documentation & LLM Knowledge Base

> paylink.lol is a real-time attention leaderboard, dynamic link directory, and live bidding discovery engine. This file contains complete, exhaustive details on the platform mechanics, data models, public APIs, rules, and technical architecture.

---

## 1. System Overview & Philosophy

paylink.lol reimagines link discovery and advertising into a gamified, real-time, zero-subscription attention leaderboard.

### Core Mechanics
- **"You pay, you rank."**: The leaderboard is ranked purely by the cumulative dollar amount attached to each listing. The project with the highest bid holds the `#1` spotlight slot.
- **Free Listing Tier ($0)**: Users can list any valid website for free. Free listings enter at the lowest active rank (or tie-break by submission timestamp). Free submissions are protected by Cloudflare Turnstile bot verification to eliminate spam.
- **Instant Outbidding / Boosting**: Any user can boost an existing listing or submit a new listing with a bid. As soon as the bid is settled via Stripe (or instant free submission), the entire leaderboard re-ranks in sub-second time.
- **Persistent Ranks**: Unlike daily or monthly recurring ad networks, a listing retains its position indefinitely until outbid by another project.
- **Click Tracking & Outbound Redirection**: External links are routed through `/go/:id` which logs analytics (referrer, anonymized timestamp) and broadcasts live click counters via SSE before performing a 302 redirect.

---

## 2. Platform Endpoints & Pages

### Web Pages
- `https://paylink.lol/`: Main interactive web application with real-time leaderboard, search, category filter, live battle ticker, submission modal, and outbid modal.
- `https://paylink.lol/rules`: Rules of engagement, ranking calculation formulas, moderation policies, and submission requirements.
- `https://paylink.lol/terms`: Platform terms of service, payment processing terms, disclaimers, and user conduct.
- `https://paylink.lol/privacy`: Privacy policy detailing zero-tracking analytics and privacy-first cookie-free design.
- `https://paylink.lol/llms.txt`: Summary AI-friendly guide.
- `https://paylink.lol/llms-full.txt`: Full comprehensive guide for AI models and automated agents.

---

## 3. Public API Specifications for Autonomous Agents

Autonomous agents (ChatGPT actions, Claude tools, Gemini agents, LangChain / LlamaIndex tools) can read and interact with paylink.lol using standard HTTP requests.

### Endpoint: GET /api/listings
Returns all active listings ordered by rank ascending (`rank: 1` is highest).

#### Query Parameters:
- `category` (optional, string): Filter by category (e.g. `AI & Automation`, `SaaS & Software`, etc.)
- `search` (optional, string): Case-insensitive keyword search matching title, description, or domain.

#### Example Response:
```json
[
  {
    "id": "lst_v9a8d7s6",
    "rank": 1,
    "title": "CryptoPulse AI",
    "url": "https://cryptopulse.example.com",
    "description": "Next-gen algorithmic trading assistant and crypto analytics.",
    "category": "AI & Automation",
    "bid_amount": 150.00,
    "clicks": 1420,
    "created_at": "2026-08-20T14:32:10.000Z",
    "updated_at": "2026-08-24T18:45:00.000Z"
  },
  {
    "id": "lst_f3k2j1h0",
    "rank": 2,
    "title": "DevToolkit",
    "url": "https://devtoolkit.example.com",
    "description": "Essential developer utilities and regex debugger.",
    "category": "Developer Tools",
    "bid_amount": 75.50,
    "clicks": 890,
    "created_at": "2026-08-21T09:12:00.000Z",
    "updated_at": "2026-08-23T11:20:00.000Z"
  }
]
```

---

### Endpoint: GET /api/listings/:id
Retrieves a single listing by its unique identifier.

#### Example Response:
```json
{
  "id": "lst_v9a8d7s6",
  "rank": 1,
  "title": "CryptoPulse AI",
  "url": "https://cryptopulse.example.com",
  "description": "Next-gen algorithmic trading assistant and crypto analytics.",
  "category": "AI & Automation",
  "bid_amount": 150.00,
  "clicks": 1420,
  "created_at": "2026-08-20T14:32:10.000Z"
}
```

---

### Endpoint: GET /api/stats
Returns real-time aggregate statistics for the entire directory.

#### Example Response:
```json
{
  "total_listings": 42,
  "highest_bid": 150.00,
  "total_bids": 1845.50,
  "active_visitors": 18
}
```

---

### Endpoint: GET /api/activity
Returns the most recent listing events, outbid battles, and leaderboard takeovers.

#### Example Response:
```json
[
  {
    "id": "act_98213",
    "type": "outbid",
    "timestamp": "2026-08-24T18:45:00.000Z",
    "listing_title": "CryptoPulse AI",
    "listing_id": "lst_v9a8d7s6",
    "amount": 25.00,
    "previous_rank": 2,
    "new_rank": 1,
    "message": "⚡ \"CryptoPulse AI\" boosted by +$25.00 to #1!"
  }
]
```

---

### Endpoint: GET /api/metadata?url=...
Extracts open graph metadata, title, favicon, and description from a target URL for automated auto-fill in submission workflows.

#### Query Parameters:
- `url` (required, string): URL-encoded web address (e.g. `https%3A%2F%2Fexample.com`)

#### Example Response:
```json
{
  "title": "Example Domain",
  "description": "This domain is for use in illustrative examples in documents.",
  "favicon": "https://example.com/favicon.ico",
  "image": "https://example.com/og.png"
}
```

---

## 4. Real-Time Streaming SSE Protocol (Server-Sent Events)

Connecting to `GET /api/live-feed` opens a persistent SSE connection. The server transmits real-time JSON payloads under standard event names:

1. `event: connected`: Broadcasted upon initial handshake. Contains current `listings`, `stats`, and `recentOutbids`.
2. `event: leaderboard_update`: Broadcasted instantly when any listing is created, edited, or outbid.
3. `event: visitors_update`: Broadcasted when the number of active visitors on paylink.lol changes.
4. `event: click_update`: Broadcasted whenever any visitor clicks a listing redirect link (`/go/:id`).

---

## 5. Moderation, Content Policies & Rules

To preserve directory quality and user safety, paylink.lol enforces strict automated and manual moderation rules:

### Allowed Content
- SaaS products, apps, websites, digital tools, APIs, open-source repositories.
- Portfolios, newsletters, podcasts, social channels, YouTube channels, creative studios.
- Legit blockchain/DeFi projects, educational platforms, communities, and indie hacker projects.

### Strictly Prohibited Content
- Phishing, credential harvesting, malware, trojans, ransomware, or exploits.
- Hate speech, harassment, illegal products/services, fraud, and pyramid schemes.
- NSFW/adult content, deceptive redirects, cloaking, and URL shortener chains designed to obscure destinations.

Any listing violating these rules is purged from the database immediately. Payments associated with prohibited listings are non-refundable as penalty for platform abuse.

---

## 6. Technical Stack & Infrastructure

- **Backend**: Node.js, TypeScript, Express, SQLite (`better-sqlite3`) with WAL mode for ultra-fast ACID transactions.
- **Frontend**: Vanilla HTML5, CSS3, modern JavaScript (no heavy runtime framework overhead, ultra-fast TTFB and LCP).
- **Payment Processing**: Stripe Checkout with cryptographic webhook verification (`STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET`).
- **Bot Defense**: Cloudflare Turnstile invisible CAPTCHA protection on zero-dollar submissions.
- **Real-Time Layer**: SSE (Server-Sent Events) with heartbeat keepalives and memory-efficient client pools.
